changelog:
* **feat: rework draft save/load flow** (14555db)
  - Remove idle "Nothing counted yet" card from the calculator home screen.
  - Keep the app open on back-exit: Save as Draft now saves and clears the calculator instead of closing the app.
  - Add a dedicated Draft page reached from a Settings link card with a red-dot badge when drafts exist.
  - Draft list rows load the draft into the calculator; the draft stays listed until it is saved to History successfully.
  - Re-saving an open draft updates it in place (new updateDraft) instead of duplicating the entry.
  - Draft detail (Report fromDraft mode) hides export/print/share and shows an About Drafts explainer card.
  - Add an empty state with icon and hint text to the Draft page; drop saveDraftToHistory from SettingsViewModel.
